name: 97024 · Fairview, OR
findings: ZIP 97024 (Fairview) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 5 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97024 (Fairview) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
